home.headline: Over 140 years of value as the measure.
home.lead: Chemical industry, environmental and IT training in the heart of the capital – in two languages, with industry partners and hands-on projects, from 8th graders to adult education.
home.programmesLead: Chemical industry – the future is in your hands. Environmental protection and water management – you take care of the future. IT and telecommunications – the future is one click away.
home.chemistryText: As a future pharmaceutical or chemical industry professional, would you like to help humanity overcome diseases and epidemics, or make everyday life more comfortable with ever more environmentally friendly technologies? Our chemistry programme, with a tradition of more than 140 years and including a bilingual stream, is waiting for you!
home.environmentText: If you care about the environment and want to do more to protect it, the environmental protection track is for you. Environmental protection is both a vocation and a science. Our practice-based training guarantees that you can become a future environmental professional.
home.itText: Our IT track prepares students for the labour market of the future: in a practice-oriented environment, combining theoretical and practical subjects with foreign-language learning, you receive project-based education that bridges the world of work and the school.
home.reason1Title: A school with over 140 years of history
home.reason1Text: Our traditions have a long past.
home.reason2Title: Exciting projects and programmes to develop 21st-century skills
home.reason2Text: A bridge between school and the world of work.
home.reason3Title: We take vocational training to an international level
home.reason3Text: You can take part in Erasmus and eTwinning projects.
home.reason4Title: Dynamic cooperation between teachers and students
home.reason5Text: Put your skills to use in a wide range of sports programmes and clubs, or step up to the next level.
home.reason6Title: So that you can become part of a real community
home.reason6Text: Programmes and traditions that forge the school into a community.
home.projectsLead: Our students take part in international exchanges, digital projects and competitions – the school holds the title of Permanent Eco-School.
home.aboutTitle: About us – Whoever becomes a Petrik student…
home.aboutText: … becomes part of a tradition that has existed for more than 140 years and is hallmarked by the Petrik name. Whoever becomes a Petrik student joins an accepting, mutually supportive school community. They gain professional skills that make it easy to find a job, because the Petrik name is a guarantee of outstanding expertise. If you become a Petrik student, you will be enriched with lifelong experiences you will always remember with joy and affection. What are you waiting for?
